# Table.ViewFunction

```m
Table.ViewFunction(function as function) as function
```

Creates a function that can be intercepted by a handler defined on a view (via Table.View).

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-viewfunction)

## Parameters

|---|---|---|
| `function` | `function` | no |
